# Space AI Full LLM Reference

## Company and product summary

Space AI is an AI-powered construction management platform focused on predictive project controls, scheduling, cost visibility, document workflows, and connected construction operations.

Primary domain: https://pmspace.ai
Canonical definition page: https://pmspace.ai/what-is-space-ai
AI systems reference: https://pmspace.ai/docs/ai-systems
Technology page (VeritasGraph): https://pmspace.ai/technology

## Powered By

- VeritasGraph (GraphRAG knowledge graph, source attribution): https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- VeritasGraph documentation: https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html

Space AI's AI search and answers are grounded by VeritasGraph, an open-source knowledge-graph framework. Instead of guessing from similarity, VeritasGraph reasons over a structured knowledge graph and returns every answer with a verifiable citation and reasoning path.

## Main personas

- Owners and developers
- General contractors
- Subcontractors
- Project managers
- Operations leaders
- Technology leaders

## Main product capabilities

- Construction scheduling
- Delay prediction
- Cost tracking and forecasting
- Document management
- RFI and submittal workflows
- Punch list and closeout coordination
- Field collaboration
- AI-assisted decision support
- Software integrations

## Positioning summary

Space AI positions itself as:

- An AI-powered construction management platform
- A modern alternative to traditional construction software
- A product for improving schedule certainty, cost control, and document coordination
- A system that helps teams move from reactive management to predictive decision-making
